name: SousShift AI
facts: SousShift AI (say it 'SOO-shift', like sous chef) builds branded apps, custom games and rewards for restaurants and local businesses.
Guests scan a QR code and the app opens in their phone browser. There is no app store, no download and no account to start.
Plans are priced per restaurant: Basic $3,000 setup + $350/mo, Growth $3,500 setup + $650/mo, Done-for-you $4,000 setup + $950/mo.
Every plan includes a custom game, points and rewards, invite-a-friend referrals, a free daily spin, a weekly leaderboard and giveaway, and a QR print kit design.
AI add-ons are per location, per month: AI Text Assistant $75 and AI Voice Host + Text $150. They are month to month.
Contact: secondshiftai@gmail.com, Instagram @SousShiftAi, or the 24/7 AI sales line (424) 296-3303. The line takes calls only, not texts.
Nia, SousShift's AI guide, answers the sales line. She explains plans and add-ons, answers questions about SousShift and connects callers to Antidote.

Live demos: Melody Bar & Grill (flight game), Nalu Vida (surf game), Gritz N Wafflez (Order Up!), StormBurger (Storm Run), Churrito Loco (Loco Match), Lucky Dragon (Hibachi Catch), plus a mechanic app and an ice cream truck app.
New plans are month-to-month after a 3-month minimum, with 30 days' written notice to cancel.

qa.q: What is SousShift AI?
qa.a: SousShift AI builds branded apps, custom games and rewards for restaurants and local businesses. Guests scan a QR, play your game, join your rewards and come back.

qa.q: How do you say SousShift?
qa.a: It's 'SOO-shift', like sous chef.

qa.q: Who is SousShift for?
qa.a: Restaurants, bars, cafés, food trucks and ice cream trucks first, plus mechanics, barbershops, salons, gyms, car washes and retail. Anyone who wants customers to come back.

qa.q: Do my customers have to download an app?
qa.a: No. They scan your QR code and it opens right in their phone's browser. They can add it to their home screen if they want it like a regular app.

qa.q: How do guests get the app?
qa.a: They scan the QR on the table, window or receipt, it opens in the browser, and they can tap Add to Home Screen. Works on any phone.

qa.q: How much does it cost?
qa.a: Per restaurant: Basic is $3,000 setup + $350/mo, Growth is $3,500 + $650/mo, and Done-for-you is $4,000 + $950/mo. AI add-ons start at $75/mo per location.

qa.q: What's in the Basic plan?
qa.a: Basic ($3,000 + $350/mo) gives you a branded app with table ordering and QR, a 4K photo menu with 3D dishes, a menu in 12 languages, points and rewards, referrals, a custom game with daily spin, weekly leaderboard and giveaway, your customer list, email, your Instagram feed, a QR print kit design, a promo video and hosting and support. You send your own texts and promotions.

qa.q: What's in the Growth plan?
qa.a: Growth ($3,500 + $650/mo) is everything in Basic plus Google review prompts, nearby/GPS alerts, the AI Text Assistant, automatic birthday and we-miss-you texts, missed-call text-back, and we place your print order. It's our most popular plan.

qa.q: What's in the Done-for-you plan?
qa.a: Done-for-you ($4,000 + $950/mo) is everything in Growth plus an AI Voice Host that answers your phone, and we run your texting and marketing for you. You approve, we do the work.

qa.q: Which plan should I pick?
qa.a: Basic if you're happy to send your own texts and place your own stickers. Growth if you want guests brought back automatically. Done-for-you if you want to sit back while we run marketing and answer the phone.

qa.q: Is the setup fee one-time?
qa.a: Yes. Setup is paid once, then you pay the monthly fee. The monthly starts the day you sign.

qa.q: Are prices per location?
qa.a: Yes, plan prices are per restaurant. If you have more than one location, each is priced on its own.

qa.q: How can I pay the setup?
qa.a: Three ways: pay it all at signing, split 50/50 (half at signing, half when your app is delivered), or the flexible plan with at least $750 down.

qa.q: How does the flexible payment plan work?
qa.a: You put at least $750 down per restaurant, and the rest of the setup is split into 12 equal pieces added to your monthly. After 12 months the monthly drops back to normal, with no extra charge for the plan.

qa.q: What is the 50/50 split?
qa.a: You pay 50% of the setup when you sign and 50% when your app is delivered (Go-Live). The monthly starts when you sign.

qa.q: Can I try it before I pay?
qa.a: Yes. We build a free sample app with your name, menu and photos and show it on your phone. No card and no pressure.

qa.q: Is there a contract?
qa.a: New agreements have a 3-month minimum, then it's month to month. Either side can cancel with 30 days' written notice (email counts).

qa.q: Can I cancel?
qa.a: Yes, after the 3-month minimum you can cancel with 30 days' written notice, and email counts. Your customer list goes with you.

qa.q: What if the app doesn't bring customers back?
qa.a: There's a results promise: if in your first 3 months after Go-Live there's no 30-day period with at least 30 tracked return visits, your next 2 monthly payments are waived. It's not a promise of sales, and fees already paid aren't refunded.

qa.q: What is the performance share?
qa.a: In a month your app customers spend more than $3,000 on food and non-alcoholic drinks, we get 10% of only the amount over $3,000. For example, $5,000 in app sales is $200. Under $3,000, nothing extra is owed.

qa.q: I'm already a client. Do my prices change?
qa.a: No. Signed deals keep their terms. The published prices are for new restaurants.

qa.q: How does this compare to buying the tools separately?
qa.a: The app bundles ordering, loyalty, referrals, a game, email, hosting and more that you'd otherwise pay several companies for. For example, phone AI like Slang.ai starts at $399 per location, versus $150/mo for our Voice Host + Text.

qa.q: Are there any extra costs?
qa.a: Printing is billed at cost, about $100-$165 per restaurant for stickers, a poster and table cards. AI add-ons have included text and minute limits, then small overage rates. Add-ons like Social & SEO are priced separately.

qa.q: How much do truck plans cost?
qa.a: Ice cream and food trucks have three plans: Single Scoop $99 setup + $29/mo (1 truck), Double Scoop $299 setup (only $199 for the first 10 trucks) + $50/mo, and Sundae $599 + $129/mo for up to 3 trucks. Order-ahead comes with Double Scoop and up.

qa.q: What do the truck plans include?
qa.a: Single Scoop has a designer QR sticker, nearby alerts, a live truck map and points with a 5-visit reward. Double Scoop adds order ahead, payments setup and an owner live view. Sundae covers up to 3 trucks with slow-day deal blasts and booking pages. No contract, move up or down any time.

qa.q: How much for a mechanic or auto shop app?
qa.a: Mechanic pricing is set per shop, so we quote it. Call (424) 296-3303 or email secondshiftai@gmail.com.

qa.q: What's the price for a barbershop, salon, gym or other non-restaurant?
qa.a: Published plans are per restaurant, and these are custom builds, so we quote them. Call (424) 296-3303 or email secondshiftai@gmail.com for a quote.

qa.q: What add-ons do you offer?
qa.a: AI Text Assistant $75/mo, AI Voice Host + Text $150/mo, Online Ordering + Delivery $300/mo (coming soon), Social & SEO Growth $1,000/mo, and quoted add-ons: Sports Bar Package, Games Pack and 3D Digital Menu.

qa.q: What is the AI Text Assistant?
qa.a: For $75/mo per location, an AI texts your customers back 24/7 with your hours, menu, specials, reservation requests and catering info. It includes 1,000 texts a month and is included in Growth and Done-for-you.

qa.q: What is the AI Voice Host?
qa.a: For $150/mo per location, a natural AI voice answers your phone 24/7 or after hours, takes reservation requests, transfers to staff and texts links. It includes the Text Assistant and is included in Done-for-you.

qa.q: Are the AI prices per location?
qa.a: Yes. They're per location, per month, on top of your package unless your plan already includes them.

qa.q: Does the AI sound like a robot?
qa.a: It uses a natural, modern voice and handles back-and-forth questions, and you can try it yourself. It says it's an AI if asked and never pretends to be a person.

qa.q: Can the AI take reservations?
qa.a: It collects reservation requests (name, party size, date, time, phone) and sends them to your staff to confirm. It doesn't book into your system or promise a table on its own.

qa.q: What if the AI doesn't know the answer?
qa.a: It doesn't guess. It tells the customer it'll get a person and texts the question to you or your manager with the customer's name and number.

qa.q: What phone number does the AI use?
qa.a: Your existing number through call forwarding, which we walk you through, or a new local number we set up for you.

qa.q: How many texts and minutes are included?
qa.a: The Text Assistant includes 1,000 texts a month, then $0.03 a text. The Voice Host + Text includes 750 call minutes and 1,000 texts a month, then $0.15 a minute and $0.03 a text.

qa.q: Are there texting rules I need to worry about?
qa.a: We follow them for you. Promotional texts only go to people who opted in, every one includes STOP to opt out, and nothing goes out in quiet hours. SousShift also handles the carrier registration, which usually takes a few days.

qa.q: How long does AI setup take?
qa.a: We load your hours, menu, specials and FAQs, then test it with you. Texting needs carrier registration (usually a few days), and the voice host needs call forwarding turned on. We handle both.

qa.q: Are the AI add-ons month to month?
qa.a: Yes. No long contract, and you can switch tiers or cancel anytime.

qa.q: Can I hear the AI voice?
qa.a: Yes. There are demo voice hosts: Kira for Melody Bar & Grill and Kai for Nalu Vida. You can also call (424) 296-3303 and talk to Nia.

qa.q: Can customers order online?
qa.a: Table ordering from the guest's phone is part of the app. Online pickup ordering with card payments is coming soon as a $300/mo add-on, or $200/mo + 5% of the food.

qa.q: Do you do delivery?
qa.a: Not yet. Delivery by DoorDash drivers is planned once DoorDash approves our access (applied, under review), and pickup ordering comes first. Your current delivery stays as it is.

qa.q: What is the Sports Bar Package?
qa.a: An add-on with live local scores, follow-your-team alerts, the Fan Test, Football Squares, fight nights and pick-the-winner points. Ask for a quote.

qa.q: What is the Games Pack?
qa.a: An add-on with trivia, sports trivia, a daily word game, a word scramble and bar-safe Truth or Dare, with points for playing. Ask for a quote.

qa.q: What is the 3D Digital Menu?
qa.a: An add-on where guests spin a real 3D model of your signature dishes, with slow-motion food clips and a real-photo mode. Ask for a quote.

qa.q: What is Social & SEO Growth?
qa.a: A $1,000/mo add-on with a content plan, short videos from your food, posting on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, Google Business Profile and local SEO, and a monthly report. Results vary and no follower or view counts are guaranteed.

qa.q: What is the Everything bundle?
qa.a: Done-for-you plus Social & SEO Growth with a $150/mo discount: $4,000 setup + $1,800/mo.

qa.q: How do rewards and points work?
qa.a: Customers earn points on visits and can level up from Regular to VIP to Legend, with a birthday treat. Points unlock rewards you choose.

qa.q: How do the weekly contests and leaderboards work?
qa.a: Customers play your custom game, and the weekly leaderboard crowns a champion who wins a prize you set. There's also a free daily spin and a weekly giveaway.

qa.q: How do referrals work?
qa.a: With invite-a-friend referrals, customers share their code. When a friend joins, both get a reward, and you see who brings in the most people.

qa.q: What is the free daily spin?
qa.a: A free spin each day that gives guests a reason to open your app daily. It's included in every plan.

qa.q: What is the gold loyalty card?
qa.a: Each member gets a gold card ID that staff can scan, plus a moving reward pass that can't be screenshotted.

qa.q: Can people cheat the rewards?
qa.a: Scout, our fraud guard, catches point farming, duplicate accounts and fake receipt claims before anyone gets rewarded.

qa.q: What is the early-bird gift?
qa.a: A founding gift or a raffle drawing for your first members, to fill your list fast.

qa.q: How do QR codes and table cards work?
qa.a: Every plan includes the designs for QR table stickers, a 24x36 window poster and numbered table cards. Guests scan and the app opens in their browser.

qa.q: How much does printing cost?
qa.a: About $100-$165 per restaurant for 50-100 stickers, one poster and 50 table cards, at typical prices. Shipping and tax are extra.

qa.q: Who does the printing?
qa.a: On Basic you order and place them using our print-ready files. On Growth and Done-for-you we place the order and bill the print cost at cost, with no markup.

qa.q: Can guests order from the table?
qa.a: Yes. Guests scan the table QR and send their order from their seat, and the app knows what table they're at.

qa.q: Does it work with Toast or Square?
qa.a: Yes, it works alongside any register (Toast, Square, Clover and others). Nothing to install, and staff look up a member by phone or scan their code. You keep your register.

qa.q: Do you replace my POS?
qa.a: No. SousShift sits on top of your register and adds the app, game and rewards.

qa.q: What languages does it support?
qa.a: The menu comes in 12 languages, including Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Armenian and Russian, one tap away. The staff app is in English and Spanish.

qa.q: What is the staff app?
qa.a: A step-by-step training app in English and Spanish with real screenshots, a Listen button and a quiz. It shows no customer data.

qa.q: What is the owner back office?
qa.a: One place to see members, visits, rewards and prices. You decide what each employee can see and change, and every change is logged.

qa.q: Who owns my customer list?
qa.a: You do. You get full access and CSV export anytime, and a complete export within 10 days if you ever stop. We never sell it or use it for another business.

qa.q: Can I text or email my customers?
qa.a: Yes. Every plan includes email to your list. Growth and Done-for-you add automatic birthday, we-miss-you and holiday texts, only to people who opted in.

qa.q: Do you help with Google reviews?
qa.a: Growth and Done-for-you include Google review prompts, so happy guests are nudged to leave a review.

qa.q: Does it show my Instagram?
qa.a: Yes. Your Instagram feed shows inside the app automatically, so you post once and it's in both places.

qa.q: Are there holiday themes?
qa.a: Yes. Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas and more switch on and off by themselves, included in the app.

qa.q: What kind of game do I get?
qa.a: A custom game themed to your food and brand, with your logo and menu in it. Guests play while they wait and a weekly top score wins a prize.

qa.q: Are the games realistic?
qa.a: Yes. Our games can be real 3D with crowds, traffic, weather, day and night, and your restaurant and neighborhood.

qa.q: What is the promo video and exposure?
qa.a: Basic and up include a promo video for your app and food, plus exposure on Antidote's food-review audience. No view counts or customers are promised.

qa.q: What about hosting and support?
qa.a: Hosting, updates and support are included in every plan. Menu and price changes are handled for you.

qa.q: How do I get started?
qa.a: Fill out the free sample form (about 3 minutes) with your business type, a few items and 2-6 photos. Antidote reviews it personally and builds your sample, usually the same day.

qa.q: What happens after I sign?
qa.a: We build your app with your logo, colors, a game made for your food and the rewards you choose. Then QR codes go on tables and the window and guests start playing.

qa.q: What are the steps to get my free sample?
qa.a: One, tell us about your business. Two, we build your sample with your name and photos. Three, you see it on your phone, play it and show your staff, then decide.

qa.q: How long does it take to launch?
qa.a: Most restaurants go live within a couple of weeks of getting us the menu, photos and logo. Your free sample is usually ready the same day.

qa.q: What do I need to give you?
qa.a: Your menu, photos, logo and deals. You also keep your setup page current with your deals.

qa.q: What do I have to do on each plan?
qa.a: Basic: you send your own texts and promotions and place your stickers. Growth: bring-back texts run themselves and we order printing. Done-for-you: we run texting and marketing, and you approve.

qa.q: Do you guarantee sales?
qa.a: No. We don't promise a set number of customers or sales. The calculator on our site gives estimates, and the results promise is the commitment.

qa.q: How many visits do I need to cover the cost?
qa.a: At a $25 average visit, about 14 extra visits a month cover Basic's $350 monthly fee. It's an estimate, not a promise.

qa.q: What demos can I try?
qa.a: Melody Bar & Grill (flight game), Nalu Vida (surf game), Gritz N Wafflez (Order Up!), StormBurger (Storm Run), Churrito Loco (Loco Match), Lucky Dragon (Hibachi Catch), plus the mechanic app, ice cream truck app and food truck app. Tap one and play it.

qa.q: Tell me about Melody Bar & Grill.
qa.a: Melody (Westchester, by LAX) is our first onboarded partner and is going live now. It has a flight game where you land the plane at LAX for prizes, a full photo menu with table ordering, star rewards, a weekly champion and a Just Landed deal for travelers.

qa.q: Tell me about Nalu Vida.
qa.a: Nalu Vida is a Venice Pier beach bar with the Ride the Nalu surf game, a 4K menu, live happy-hour and brunch status, and rewards with a weekly champion. It's still in the works and not live yet.

qa.q: Tell me about Gritz N Wafflez.
qa.a: Gritz N Wafflez is a Koreatown, woman-owned breakfast spot. The Order Up! game has you run the kitchen and serve plates while you wait, with a weekly prize board, a karaoke shoutout for the top score and reward codes good for 3 days.

qa.q: Tell me about StormBurger.
qa.a: StormBurger (Inglewood and Long Beach) is a demo sample with the Storm Run driving game, a build-your-burger menu and rewards.

qa.q: Tell me about Churrito Loco.
qa.a: Churrito Loco (South Gate) is a demo sample with Loco Match, a Candy-Crush style puzzle game with their mascot, plus rewards.

qa.q: Tell me about Lucky Dragon.
qa.a: Lucky Dragon Hibachi (Compton) is a demo sample with the Hibachi Catch dragon game and a build-your-hibachi-plate menu.

qa.q: Do you have a mechanic app demo?
qa.a: Yes, Your Auto Shop. Customers type or tap what's wrong, see a sample price or ask for a quote, check tire stock, book and pay by QR, plus service reminders and recall alerts.

qa.q: Do you have an ice cream truck demo?
qa.a: Yes. Customers see a live map, get a Truck's on your street alert and an arrival ETA, and earn points with a 5-check-in reward.

qa.q: Do you have a food truck demo?
qa.a: Yes. It has a live map, today's stops, a deals board and order-ahead timed so food comes off the grill as the customer walks up, plus an owner live view.

qa.q: Do you do apps for lawyers or bail bonds?
qa.a: Yes, there are two legal demos: Courtroom Practice (a practice game with real public-record cases) and Court Companion (court dates, reminders and lawyer tasks). Both can carry a firm's brand.

qa.q: Will it work for my type of business?
qa.a: Yes. We build for restaurants, bars, cafés, trucks, bakeries, mechanics, barbershops, salons, gyms, car washes, retail, boba and more. If there's no existing demo for your type, we build a custom game in the same style.

qa.q: Can I get a custom game for my business?
qa.a: Yes. Every game is custom and themed to your business. Where no existing demo fits, we design a new concept, such as a fade-cutting game for a barbershop.

qa.q: Can I just talk to someone?
qa.a: Yes. Call our 24/7 AI sales line at (424) 296-3303 and Nia, SousShift's AI guide, will explain the plans and add-ons, answer your questions and connect you to Antidote. It's calls only, so please don't text that number.

qa.a: Nia is SousShift's AI guide. She answers the 24/7 sales line at (424) 296-3303, explains plans and add-ons, answers questions about SousShift and connects callers to Antidote.

qa.a: Call (424) 296-3303 any time, email secondshiftai@gmail.com or DM @SousShiftAi. You can also fill out the free sample form and we'll build a demo with your menu.

qa.q: When can I call?
